objectives: Students will demonstrate the knowledge and skills to implement and sustain a business concept, Couture a la Cart on the UGA campus.
Students will compare and contrast the successes and challenges of past iterations of CALC to inform decision making and set realistic goals.
Students will act as a CALC employee working individually and cross-functionally in a team environment.
Students will understand the necessity of vulnerability, risk taking, and failure as components of innovation and critical problem solving.

Metrics of success, mission statement, entrepreneurial vision
Consumer analysis and budget proposals
Product mix, procurement, and vendor relations
Location analysis, permissions, and golf cart preparation
Marketing and merchandising
Go to market, selling season and ongoing analysis
Concluding selling, vendor payouts, budget finalization, and final reporting

objectives: Students will gain a foundational understanding of woven and knitted textile design principles and their applications in fashion industries.
Students will develop proficiency in using software tools for designing digital woven and knitted textiles.
Students will fabricate creative textile structures and interpret their behaviors.
Students will understand the process of translating digital textile designs into physical fabrics.
Students will acquire the skills to work with textile machinery and understand the key factors in achieving quality and troubleshooting.

objectives: Students will understand how to analyze the current market, competitive landscape, and marketing and promotional strategies for an apparel brand or fashion retail business.
Students will understand how to develop a market-responsive apparel product line for an apparel brand or fashion retail business.
Students will understand how to create merchandising and assortment recommendations for an apparel brand or fashion retail business.
Students will understand how to examine various factors from the FACS Body of Knowledge and assess the impact on consumers fashion choices and merchandising strategies.
Students will understand how to demonstrate cross-functional team collaboration and effective communication and presentation skills for fashion industry professional settings.
Students will understand how to compose a professional persona representing the culminating experience of the fashion merchandising major in preparation for post-graduation industry placement.
